answer_1.quote: We introduce REFEREE, a new framework for sentence summarization ... Our work follows the paradigm of Symbolic Knowledge Distillation ... REFEREE works in two phases ... sentence summarization model ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models based on BERTScore and ROUGE-1,2,L against the original sentence ... We also report bucket accuracy and compression ratio ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to verify the qualities of summaries from REFEREE-DISTILL. We measure 3 axes: faithfulness, relevance and fluency, each on a 3-point Likert scale ... Fleiss κ ... indicating fair to moderate agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each summary on three criteria (faithfulness, relevance, fluency) using a 3‑point Likert scale.
